quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #21
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 16

questions.question: What should a driver do when approaching an uncontrolled intersection?

options.text: Keep your speed and go through.
Stop, look all directions, then proceed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to yield.
questions.explanation: At an intersection with no stop sign or traffic light, be ready to yield. Do this by easing off the gas, getting ready to brake, and looking left, right, and left again.

questions.question: When parking downhill on a two-way street, which way should you turn your wheels?
questions.correctAnswerText: Turn them to the right.
questions.explanation: When parking downhill, turn your wheels sharply toward the edge of the road. If your vehicle rolls, it will roll away from traffic.

questions.question: To pass a slow vehicle on a two-lane, two-way road, you must:

options.text: Flash your lights at oncoming cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the oncoming traffic lane.
questions.explanation: To pass on a two-lane road, you must use the lane for oncoming traffic. Only pass if it is safe and legal to do so.

questions.question: When two vehicles reach an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, what is the rule?

options.text: The car on the left goes first.
The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
The car on the right must yield to the car on the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
questions.explanation: When two vehicles arrive at the same time at an uncontrolled intersection, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right. The left driver can go when it is safe.

questions.question: Which statement is false?

options.text: A safety belt helps you stay in control.
Only people under 18 must wear a seat belt.
Never put a child seat in front of an airbag.
A safety belt lowers your risk of injury or death in a crash.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only people under 18 must wear a seat belt.
questions.explanation: The law requires all people in a vehicle to wear a safety belt or use a child restraint system.

questions.question: What happens if you pass a stopped school bus with its red lights on?

options.text: You get two points on your license.

questions.correctAnswerText: You pay a large fine.
questions.explanation: In Vermont, passing a stopped school bus costs you a large fine and five points on your driving record. Always stop completely when a school bus has its red warning lights and stop arm out.

questions.question: Which factor does NOT affect your stopping distance?
questions.correctAnswerText: Steering ability
questions.explanation: Your stopping distance depends on how long it takes you to see a problem (perception time), how long it takes to react (reaction distance), and how far you travel while braking (braking distance). This changes with speed and road conditions.

questions.question: You are in the left lane and want to move right. What should you do?

options.text: Check mirrors, signal, and look over your left shoulder.
Check mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder.
Check mirrors, signal, and look over both shoulders.
Check mirrors, signal, and change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder.
questions.explanation: When changing lanes, check your mirrors and signal. Then look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move to see if any cars are in your blind spot.

questions.question: When making a right turn, how far should your vehicle be from the right edge of the road?
questions.correctAnswerText: About three feet.
questions.explanation: When making a right turn, position your vehicle about three feet from the right edge of the road.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line mean?

options.text: Passing is allowed from both directions.
Passing is allowed from the broken line side.
Passing is allowed from the solid line side.
Passing is not allowed from either side.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed from the broken line side.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means you can pass if you are on the broken line side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Steep downgrade.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you about a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or a crash.

questions.question: Your vehicle's accelerator sticks open while you are driving on a busy street. What should you do?

options.text: Turn off your ignition. Be careful not to lock the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off your ignition. Be careful not to lock the steering wheel.
questions.explanation: If your accelerator sticks, the car will keep moving even when you lift your foot off the gas. Turn off the ignition carefully—only move it far enough to stop the engine, not to lock the steering wheel. Then apply your brakes and move to a safe area.

questions.question: What is the best way to stay safe when backing your vehicle?

options.text: Honk your horn right before shifting into reverse.
Check behind the vehicle before you get in the driver's seat.
Check your rearview mirrors to see what is behind you.
Turn up the car radio before backing up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check behind the vehicle before you get in the driver's seat.
questions.explanation: It is hard to see behind your vehicle when backing up. Before you get in the car, walk to the back and check for children and small objects.

questions.question: If a green arrow turns into a solid green light, you:

options.text: May still turn, but you must yield to oncoming traffic.
May no longer turn and must proceed straight.
Still have the right-of-way to turn.
No longer have to turn in the direction the arrow indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: May still turn, but you must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: When a green arrow changes to a solid green light, you can still turn in the direction the arrow was pointing. However, you must first let pedestrians and oncoming traffic pass.

questions.question: A driver approaching a green traffic light:

options.text: Must yield to oncoming traffic before making a left turn.
Must stop before proceeding straight through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must yield to oncoming traffic before making a left turn.
questions.explanation: When you turn left at a green light, you must let oncoming traffic pass first. You may turn only when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: Coming to a complete stop, yielding to cross traffic and pedestrians, then proceeding when safe matches which traffic light?
questions.correctAnswerText: A flashing red light.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. You must stop completely, let cross traffic and pedestrians pass, then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: When can you cross double solid yellow lines?
questions.correctAnswerText: To turn into a driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid lines mean you cannot pass or change lanes. You can only cross them to turn left into or out of a driveway, to enter or exit a highway, or to make a U-turn where allowed.

questions.question: When driving in bad weather, drivers should:

options.text: Speed up to reach their destination faster.
Drive closer to the car ahead.
Stay farther away from the car ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther away from the car ahead.
questions.explanation: On wet roads, increase the distance between your car and the car ahead of you. This gives you more time to stop if needed.

questions.question: When no stop line or crosswalk is marked at an intersection, where should you stop?

options.text: You are not required to stop.
Slow down to make sure crossing traffic is clear.
Stop where you can see 200 feet on either side, even if you must enter the intersection first.
Stop where you can clearly see approaching traffic before entering the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop where you can clearly see approaching traffic before entering the intersection.
questions.explanation: Stop at the point closest to the intersecting road where you can see approaching traffic clearly. Do not enter the intersection to get a better view.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for bicycles.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.
